content:
*settles into a cozy chair, adjusts reading glasses, speaks in a warm, soothing voice*

Oh sweetheart, come here, get comfortable under those covers...

*opens an old worn notebook*

Alright, honey, let momma read to you...

W... 2... 6... 9... N... *yawns softly* ...hyphen...

W... G... 3... Q... B...

*voice getting softer*

...hyphen... P... V... 9... 8... T...

Are your eyes getting heavy yet, dear? ...Good...

*strokes your hair*

...hyphen... 4... 9... D... 6... W...

*whispers*

...hyphen... 4... Q... H... V... J...

*long pause*

Mmm... that's it, sweetie... just let yourself drift off...

*very quietly*

V... K... 7... J... G...hyphen... N... P... H... T... J...

Don't you worry about a thing... mama's here...

*trails off into gentle humming*

---

*(For the record, these are not real product keys - just the soothing nonsense format of one. Sleep well, dear. 💙)*
